# IUCN continental 0.1 budget

```{r}
# Function to analyze priority data
analyze_priority_data <- function(data, index_name) {
  total_cells <- nrow(data)
  nonzero_cells <- sum(data$Priority > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  zero_cells <- sum(data$Priority == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  na_cells <- sum(is.na(data$Priority))
  
  # Get non-zero priorities for quantiles
  nonzero_priority <- data$Priority[data$Priority > 0]
  
  # Create summary data frame
  summary_df <- data.frame(
    Index = index_name,
    Total_Cells = total_cells,
    Nonzero_Cells = nonzero_cells,
    Nonzero_Percent = round(nonzero_cells/total_cells*100, 2),
    Zero_Cells = zero_cells,
    Zero_Percent = round(zero_cells/total_cells*100, 2),
    NA_Cells = na_cells,
    NA_Percent = round(na_cells/total_cells*100, 2),
    Min = min(data$Priority, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q25 = quantile(data$Priority, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median = median(data$Priority, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean = mean(data$Priority, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q75 = quantile(data$Priority, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max = max(data$Priority, na.rm = TRUE),
    NonZero_Median = median(nonzero_priority, na.rm = TRUE),
    NonZero_Mean = mean(nonzero_priority, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  
  return(summary_df)
}

# Analyze EDGE2 only
iucn_summary <- analyze_priority_data(CAPTAIN2_IUCN_data, "IUCN")

# Create a nicely formatted table
kable(iucn_summary,
      format = "html",
      digits = 2,
      col.names = c("Index", "Total Cells", "Non-zero Cells", "Non-zero %",
                    "Zero Cells", "Zero %", "NA Cells", "NA %",
                    "Min", "Q25", "Median", "Mean", "Q75", "Max",
                    "Non-zero Median", "Non-zero Mean"),
      caption = "Summary Statistics of IUCN Conservation Priority Values",
      row.names = FALSE) %>%  # Add this parameter
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"),
                full_width = FALSE,
                font_size = 12) %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Cell Counts" = 7, "All Cells Statistics" = 6, "Non-zero Only" = 2)) %>%
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE, width = "4em") %>%
  column_spec(2:8, width = "6em") %>%
  column_spec(9:16, width = "5em")

# Get the dimensions of the raster
nrows <- nrow(r)
ncols <- ncol(r)

# Confirm dimensions match expected values
if (nrows != 323 || ncols != 720) {
  warning("Raster dimensions don't match expected values. Proceeding with actual dimensions.")
}

# Create a grid of coordinates for each cell
# This gives us the center coordinates of each cell
coords <- as.data.frame(coordinates(r))
names(coords) <- c("Longitude", "Latitude")

# Add cell IDs (PUID) to the coordinates
coords$PUID <- 1:nrow(coords)

# Now join with the CAPTAIN2 IUCN data based on PUID
CAPTAIN2_IUCN_data_with_coords <- CAPTAIN2_IUCN_data %>%
  left_join(coords, by = "PUID")

# Check if the join worked correctly
if (sum(is.na(CAPTAIN2_IUCN_data_with_coords$Longitude)) > 0) {
  warning("Some PUIDs from CAPTAIN2 IUCN data couldn't be matched to coordinates.")
}

# Filter to keep only cells with non-zero priority for faster plotting
CAPTAIN2_IUCN_data_nonzero <- CAPTAIN2_IUCN_data_with_coords %>%
  filter(Priority > 0) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Longitude), !is.na(Latitude))  # Remove any rows with missing coords

# Get world map data
world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

# Define the McBryde-Thomas 2 projection
mcbryde_thomas_2 <- "+proj=mbt_s"

# Transform the dataset to sf object and project
CAPTAIN2_IUCN_sf <- st_as_sf(
  CAPTAIN2_IUCN_data_nonzero, 
  coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), 
  crs = crs(r, asText = TRUE)  # Use the raster's CRS
) %>%
  st_transform(crs = mcbryde_thomas_2)

# Project the world map
world_projected_CAPTAIN2_IUCN <- st_transform(world, crs = mcbryde_thomas_2)

# Create the globe bounding box
globe_bbox <- rbind(c(-180, -90), c(-180, 90), 
                    c(180, 90), c(180, -90), c(-180, -90))

# Create the globe border
globe_border_CAPTAIN2_IUCN <- st_polygon(list(globe_bbox)) %>%
  st_sfc(crs = 4326) %>%
  st_sf(data.frame(rgn = 'globe', geom = .)) %>%
  smoothr::densify(max_distance = 0.5) %>%
  st_transform(crs = mcbryde_thomas_2)

# Create base theme
my_theme_CAPTAIN2_IUCN <- theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.margin = margin(t = 20, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0),
    legend.title = element_text(margin = margin(b = 10)),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),      # Add this line
    axis.ticks = element_blank()      # Add this line
  )

# Create the plot
CAPTAIN2_IUCN_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = CAPTAIN2_IUCN_sf, aes(color = Priority), size = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_sf(data = world_projected_CAPTAIN2_IUCN, fill = "lightgrey", color = "lightgrey", size = 0.1) +
  geom_sf(data = globe_border_CAPTAIN2_IUCN, fill = NA, color = "black", size = 0.5) +
  scale_color_gradientn(
    colors = c("white", "yellow", "darkblue"),
    values = c(0, 0.5, 1),
    name = "Priority",
    guide = guide_colorbar(barwidth = 20, barheight = 0.5, 
                         title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  labs(title = "Global Conservation Priorities",
       subtitle = "CAPTAIN2 - IUCN Index, Budget: 0.1, Replicates: 50",
       x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  my_theme_CAPTAIN2_IUCN

# Display the plot
```

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Conservation priorities for the IUCN dimension at a 10% protection target (frequency of selection across 50 CAPTAIN predictions)"
print(CAPTAIN2_IUCN_plot)
```

```{r}

# Save the plot
ggsave(
  filename = here::here("R","Outputs", "report_priorities_IUCN.png"),
  plot = CAPTAIN2_IUCN_plot,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)
```

# Difference maps

```{r}
# Create a grid of coordinates for each cell
coords <- as.data.frame(coordinates(r))
names(coords) <- c("Longitude", "Latitude")

# Add cell IDs (PUID) to the coordinates
coords$PUID <- 1:nrow(coords)

# Join all three datasets with coordinates
IUCN_with_coords <- CAPTAIN2_IUCN_data %>%
  dplyr::select(PUID, IUCN = Priority) %>%
  left_join(coords, by = "PUID")

EDGE2_with_coords <- CAPTAIN2_EDGE2_data %>%
  dplyr::select(PUID, EDGE2 = Priority) %>%
  left_join(coords, by = "PUID") 

FUSE_with_coords <- CAPTAIN2_FUSE_data %>%
  dplyr::select(PUID, FUSE = Priority) %>%
  left_join(coords, by = "PUID")

# Combine all datasets
all_indices <- coords %>%
  left_join(CAPTAIN2_IUCN_data %>% dplyr::select(PUID, IUCN = Priority), by = "PUID") %>%
  left_join(CAPTAIN2_EDGE2_data %>% dplyr::select(PUID, EDGE2 = Priority), by = "PUID") %>%
  left_join(CAPTAIN2_FUSE_data %>% dplyr::select(PUID, FUSE = Priority), by = "PUID")

# Calculate differences
all_indices <- all_indices %>%
  mutate(
    # Replace NA with 0 for calculation purposes
    IUCN = ifelse(is.na(IUCN), 0, IUCN),
    EDGE2 = ifelse(is.na(EDGE2), 0, EDGE2),
    FUSE = ifelse(is.na(FUSE), 0, FUSE),
    
    # Calculate differences
    IUCN_minus_FUSE = IUCN - FUSE,
    IUCN_minus_EDGE2 = IUCN - EDGE2,
    EDGE2_minus_FUSE = EDGE2 - FUSE
  )

# Get world map data
world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

# Define the McBryde-Thomas 2 projection
mcbryde_thomas_2 <- "+proj=mbt_s"

# Create the globe bounding box
globe_bbox <- rbind(c(-180, -90), c(-180, 90), 
                    c(180, 90), c(180, -90), c(-180, -90))

# Create the globe border
globe_border <- st_polygon(list(globe_bbox)) %>%
  st_sfc(crs = 4326) %>%
  st_sf(data.frame(rgn = 'globe', geom = .)) %>%
  smoothr::densify(max_distance = 0.5) %>%
  st_transform(crs = mcbryde_thomas_2)

# Project the world map
world_projected <- st_transform(world, crs = mcbryde_thomas_2)

# Create base theme
my_theme <- theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.margin = margin(t = 20, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0),
    legend.title = element_text(margin = margin(b = 10)),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),      # Add this line
    axis.ticks = element_blank()      # Add this line
  )

# Filter to non-zero differences for each comparison to reduce plot size
# IUCN - FUSE
IUCN_FUSE_diff <- all_indices %>%
  filter(IUCN_minus_FUSE != 0) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = crs(r, asText = TRUE)) %>%
  st_transform(crs = mcbryde_thomas_2)

# IUCN - EDGE2
IUCN_EDGE2_diff <- all_indices %>%
  filter(IUCN_minus_EDGE2 != 0) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = crs(r, asText = TRUE)) %>%
  st_transform(crs = mcbryde_thomas_2)

# EDGE2 - FUSE
EDGE2_FUSE_diff <- all_indices %>%
  filter(EDGE2_minus_FUSE != 0) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = crs(r, asText = TRUE)) %>%
  st_transform(crs = mcbryde_thomas_2)

# Create a diverging color palette for difference maps
# Blue for negative (first index lower), white for zero, red for positive (first index higher)
diff_colors <- c("#2166AC", "#4393C3", "#92C5DE", "#D1E5F0", "#FFFFFF", 
                "#FDDBC7", "#F4A582", "#D6604D", "#B2182B")

# 1. IUCN - FUSE Difference Map
IUCN_FUSE_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = globe_border, fill = "#F8F8F8", color = NA) +
  geom_sf(data = IUCN_FUSE_diff, aes(color = IUCN_minus_FUSE), size = 0.5) +
  geom_sf(data = world_projected, fill = "lightgrey", color = "darkgrey", size = 0.1) +
  geom_sf(data = globe_border, fill = NA, color = "black", size = 0.5) +
  scale_color_gradientn(
    colors = diff_colors,
    limits = c(-1, 1),
    breaks = seq(-1, 1, by = 0.25),
    labels = as.character(seq(-1, 1, by = 0.25)),
    name = "Difference in Priority (IUCN - FUSE)",
    guide = guide_colorbar(barwidth = 20, barheight = 0.5, 
                         title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  labs(title = "Difference in Conservation Priorities",
       subtitle = "IUCN Index minus FUSE Index",
       x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  my_theme

# 2. IUCN - EDGE2 Difference Map

  geom_sf(data = globe_border, fill = "#F8F8F8", color = NA) +
```

# Species level priorities

```{r}
# Rename column in shark_metrics to match better
shark_metrics <- shark_metrics %>%
  rename(Species = `Species name`)

# Order shark_metrics alphabetically by Species name
shark_metrics <- shark_metrics %>%
  arrange(Species)

# Add an original order ID to protected_fractions to maintain its original order
protected_fractions$original_order <- 1:nrow(protected_fractions)

# Add row number as IDs to both datasets
protected_fractions$protected_ID <- 1:nrow(protected_fractions)
shark_metrics$species_ID <- 1:nrow(shark_metrics)

# Check if the datasets have the same number of rows
if(nrow(protected_fractions) == nrow(shark_metrics)) {
  # Create index mapping
  indices <- data.frame(
    protected_ID = 1:nrow(protected_fractions),
    species_ID = 1:nrow(shark_metrics)
  )
  
  # Join protected_fractions with indices
  protected_with_indices <- protected_fractions %>%
    left_join(indices, by = "protected_ID")
  
  # Join shark_metrics with indices
  shark_with_indices <- shark_metrics %>%
    left_join(indices, by = "species_ID")
  
  # Now join the datasets
  combined_data <- protected_with_indices %>%
    inner_join(
      shark_with_indices,
      by = c("species_ID", "protected_ID"),
      suffix = c("_captain", "_original")
    ) %>%
    arrange(original_order)
  
  
  # Define IUCN categories and order
  iucn_order <- c("LC", "NT", "VU", "EN", "CR")
  
  iucn_colors <- c(
    "LC" = "#60C659",
    "NT" = "#CCE226",
    "VU" = "#F9E814",
    "EN" = "#FC7F3F",
    "CR" = "#D81E05"
  )
  
  # Calculate sample sizes for each group
  iucn_n <- combined_data %>%
    group_by(IUCN_original) %>%
    summarise(n = n()) %>%
    arrange(IUCN_original)
  
  fuse_n <- combined_data %>%
    group_by(FUSE_original) %>%
    summarise(n = n()) %>%
    arrange(FUSE_original)
  
  edge2_n <- combined_data %>%
    group_by(EDGE2_original) %>%
    summarise(n = n()) %>%
    arrange(EDGE2_original)
  
  # Create x-axis labels with sample sizes
  iucn_labels <- paste0(iucn_order, "\n(n=", iucn_n$n, ")")
  fuse_labels <- paste0(1:5, "\n(n=", fuse_n$n, ")")
  edge2_labels <- paste0(1:5, "\n(n=", edge2_n$n, ")")
  
  # Define color palettes
iucn_colors <- c(
  "LC" = "#60C659",
  "NT" = "#CCE226",
  "VU" = "#F9E814",
  "EN" = "#FC7F3F",
  "CR" = "#D81E05"
)

# For FUSE - Blues

  "1" = "#c6dbef",
  "2" = "#9ecae1",
  "3" = "#6baed6",
  "4" = "#3182bd",
  "5" = "#08519c"
)

# For EDGE2 - Purples
edge2_colors <- c(
  "1" = "#dadaeb",
  "2" = "#bcbddc",
  "3" = "#9e9ac8",
  "4" = "#756bb1",
  "5" = "#54278f"
)

# 1. IUCN plot
iucn_plot <- combined_data %>%
  mutate(
    IUCN_status = factor(IUCN_original, levels = 1:5, labels = iucn_order),
    protection_percentage = IUCN_captain * 100
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = IUCN_status, y = protection_percentage)) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = IUCN_status),
              width = 0.1,
              size = 0.4,
              alpha = 0.7) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean,
               geom = "point",
               size = 3,
               color = "black") +
  stat_summary(fun.data = function(x) {
    mean_val <- mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    se_val <- sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(x)))
    return(data.frame(y = mean_val,
                      ymin = max(0, mean_val - se_val),
                      ymax = min(100, mean_val + se_val)))
  },
  geom = "errorbar",
  width = 0.1,
  color = "black") +
  labs(
    x = "IUCN Red List threat status",
    y = "Range protected (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 20),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),

  scale_x_discrete(limits = iucn_order, labels = iucn_labels) +

# 2. FUSE plot
fuse_plot <- combined_data %>%
  mutate(
    FUSE_category = factor(FUSE_original),
    protection_percentage = FUSE_captain * 100
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = FUSE_category, y = protection_percentage)) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = FUSE_category),
              width = 0.1,
              size = 0.4,
              alpha = 1) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean,
               geom = "point",
               size = 3,
               color = "black") +
  stat_summary(fun.data = function(x) {
    mean_val <- mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    se_val <- sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(x)))
    return(data.frame(y = mean_val,
                      ymin = max(0, mean_val - se_val),
                      ymax = min(100, mean_val + se_val)))
  },
  geom = "errorbar",
  width = 0.1,
  color = "black") +
  labs(
    x = "FUSE Score",
    y = "Range protected (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 20),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16)
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = fuse_labels) +
  scale_color_manual(values = fuse_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 105),
                     breaks = seq(0, 100, 25))

# 3. EDGE2 plot
edge2_plot <- combined_data %>%
  mutate(
    EDGE2_category = factor(EDGE2_original),
    protection_percentage = EDGE2_captain * 100
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = EDGE2_category, y = protection_percentage)) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = EDGE2_category),
              width = 0.1,
              size = 0.4,
              alpha = 1) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean,
               geom = "point",
               size = 3,
               color = "black") +
  stat_summary(fun.data = function(x) {
    mean_val <- mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    se_val <- sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(x)))
    return(data.frame(y = mean_val,
                      ymin = max(0, mean_val - se_val),
                      ymax = min(100, mean_val + se_val)))
  },
  geom = "errorbar",
  width = 0.1,
  color = "black") +
  labs(
    x = "EDGE2 Score",
    y = "Range protected (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 20),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16)
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = edge2_labels) +
  scale_color_manual(values = edge2_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 105),
                     breaks = seq(0, 100, 25))
  
  # Combine the three plots into a grid
  combined_plots <- ggpubr::ggarrange(
    iucn_plot,
    fuse_plot,
    edge2_plot,
    ncol = 3,
    nrow = 1,
    labels = c("(A)", "(B)", "(C)"),
    font.label = list(size = 16,
                      face = "bold",
                      hjust = -2,
                      vjust = 1.5)
  )
  
  #print(combined_plots)
  
  # Save combined plot
  ggsave(here::here("R","Outputs", "Fig3_protection_by_class.png"),
         combined_plots, width = 20, height = 6, dpi = 150, bg = "white")

  #======================
  # Beta Regression Analysis
  #======================
  
  # Prepare data for beta regression
  model_data <- combined_data %>%
    mutate(
      IUCN_status = IUCN_original,
      FUSE_score = FUSE_original,
      EDGE2_score = EDGE2_original,
      IUCN_protection = IUCN_captain * 100,
      FUSE_protection = FUSE_captain * 100,
      EDGE2_protection = EDGE2_captain * 100,
      # Convert to (0,1) scale and handle boundaries
      n_obs = n(),
      IUCN_protection_beta = (IUCN_protection/100 * (n_obs - 1) + 0.5) / n_obs,
      FUSE_protection_beta = (FUSE_protection/100 * (n_obs - 1) + 0.5) / n_obs,
      EDGE2_protection_beta = (EDGE2_protection/100 * (n_obs - 1) + 0.5) / n_obs
    )
  
  # Fit beta regression models
  iucn_beta <- betareg(IUCN_protection_beta ~ IUCN_status, data = model_data)
  fuse_beta <- betareg(FUSE_protection_beta ~ FUSE_score, data = model_data)
  edge2_beta <- betareg(EDGE2_protection_beta ~ EDGE2_score, data = model_data)
  
  # View summaries
  cat("\nIUCN beta regression\n")
  print(summary(iucn_beta))
  
  cat("\nFUSE beta regression\n")
  print(summary(fuse_beta))
  
  cat("\nEDGE2 beta regression\n")
  print(summary(edge2_beta))
  
  # Get tidy summaries
  iucn_tidy <- tidy(iucn_beta)
  fuse_tidy <- tidy(fuse_beta)
  edge2_tidy <- tidy(edge2_beta)
  
  # Get pseudo R²
  iucn_r2 <- cor(predict(iucn_beta), model_data$IUCN_protection_beta)^2
  fuse_r2 <- cor(predict(fuse_beta), model_data$FUSE_protection_beta)^2
  edge2_r2 <- cor(predict(edge2_beta), model_data$EDGE2_protection_beta)^2
  
  # Calculate marginal effects (average change in percentage per unit increase)
  iucn_margins <- margins(iucn_beta)
  fuse_margins <- margins(fuse_beta)
  edge2_margins <- margins(edge2_beta)
  
  # Extract AME and SE
  iucn_ame_summary <- summary(iucn_margins)
  fuse_ame_summary <- summary(fuse_margins)
  edge2_ame_summary <- summary(edge2_margins)
  
  # Convert to percentage (margins gives proportions)
  iucn_ame <- iucn_ame_summary$AME * 100
  iucn_ame_se <- iucn_ame_summary$SE * 100
  
  fuse_ame <- fuse_ame_summary$AME * 100
  fuse_ame_se <- fuse_ame_summary$SE * 100
  
  edge2_ame <- edge2_ame_summary$AME * 100
  edge2_ame_se <- edge2_ame_summary$SE * 100
  
  cat("\nAverage marginal effects (%)\n")
  cat(paste("IUCN AME:", round(iucn_ame, 2), "%, SE:", round(iucn_ame_se, 2), "%\n"))
  cat(paste("FUSE AME:", round(fuse_ame, 2), "%, SE:", round(fuse_ame_se, 2), "%\n"))
  cat(paste("EDGE2 AME:", round(edge2_ame, 2), "%, SE:", round(edge2_ame_se, 2), "%\n"))
  
  # Calculate predicted values and differences
  # IUCN predictions
  iucn_pred <- predict(iucn_beta,
                       newdata = data.frame(IUCN_status = 1:5),
                       type = "response") * 100
  
  cat("\nPredicted protection by IUCN category:\n")
  print(data.frame(Category = 1:5,
                   IUCN_Category = c("LC", "NT", "VU", "EN", "CR"),
                   Predicted_Protection = round(iucn_pred, 2)))
  
  iucn_avg_increase <- mean(diff(iucn_pred))
  cat(paste("Average increase per IUCN category:", round(iucn_avg_increase, 2), "%\n"))
  
  # FUSE predictions
  fuse_pred <- predict(fuse_beta,
                       newdata = data.frame(FUSE_score = 1:5),
                       type = "response") * 100
  
  cat("\nPredicted protection by FUSE score:\n")
  print(data.frame(Score = 1:5,
                   Predicted_Protection = round(fuse_pred, 2)))
  
  fuse_avg_increase <- mean(diff(fuse_pred))
  cat(paste("Average increase per FUSE unit:", round(fuse_avg_increase, 2), "%\n"))
  
  # EDGE2 predictions
  edge2_pred <- predict(edge2_beta,
                        newdata = data.frame(EDGE2_score = 1:5),
                        type = "response") * 100
  
  cat("\nPredicted protection by EDGE2 score:\n")
  print(data.frame(Score = 1:5,
                   Predicted_Protection = round(edge2_pred, 2)))
  
  edge2_avg_increase <- mean(diff(edge2_pred))
  cat(paste("Average increase per EDGE2 unit:", round(edge2_avg_increase, 2), "%\n"))
  
  # Create comprehensive summary table with AME
  comprehensive_summary <- data.frame(
    Approach = c("IUCN", "FUSE", "EDGE2"),
    Coefficient_logit = c(
      iucn_tidy$estimate[2],
      fuse_tidy$estimate[2],
      edge2_tidy$estimate[2]
    ),
    SE = c(
      iucn_tidy$std.error[2],
      fuse_tidy$std.error[2],
      edge2_tidy$std.error[2]
    ),
    z_value = c(
      iucn_tidy$statistic[2],
      fuse_tidy$statistic[2],
      edge2_tidy$statistic[2]
    ),
    P_value = c(
      iucn_tidy$p.value[2],
      fuse_tidy$p.value[2],
      edge2_tidy$p.value[2]
    ),
    AME_percent = c(
      iucn_ame,
      fuse_ame,
      edge2_ame
    ),
    AME_SE = c(
      iucn_ame_se,
      fuse_ame_se,
      edge2_ame_se
    ),
    Pseudo_R2 = c(iucn_r2, fuse_r2, edge2_r2)
  )
  
  cat("\nSummary of beta regressions\n")
  print(comprehensive_summary)
  
  # Save results
  write.csv(comprehensive_summary,
            here::here("R","Outputs", "data_beta_regression.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)
  
} else {
  cat("ERROR: Datasets have different number of rows.\n")
  cat("Protected fractions:", nrow(protected_fractions), "rows\n")
  cat("Shark metrics:", nrow(shark_metrics), "rows\n")
}
```

```{r}

#======================
# COMPREHENSIVE BETA REGRESSION DIAGNOSTICS FOR CAPTAIN MODELS
#======================


library(car)
library(moments)

# Function to check all assumptions
check_captain_beta_comprehensive <- function(data, response_var, predictor_var, model, model_name) {
  
  cat("Diagnostics for the", model_name, "model\n")
  
  # 1. Levene's test for homogeneity of variance
  cat("\n1. LEVENE'S TEST (Homogeneity of Variance):\n")
  levene_formula <- as.formula(paste(response_var, "~ factor(", predictor_var, ")"))
  levene_result <- leveneTest(levene_formula, data = data)
  print(levene_result)
  
  if(levene_result$`Pr(>F)`[1] < 0.05) {
    cat("→ Heterogeneity of variance detected (p < 0.05) ✗\n")
  } else {
    cat("→ Homogeneity of variance assumption met (p ≥ 0.05) ✓\n")
  }
  
  # 2. Shapiro-Wilk test on beta regression residuals
  cat("\n2. SHAPIRO-WILK TEST (Normality of Residuals):\n")
  dev_resid <- residuals(model, type = "deviance")
  shapiro_test <- shapiro.test(dev_resid)
  cat("W =", round(shapiro_test$statistic, 4), 
      ", p-value =", format.pval(shapiro_test$p.value, digits = 3), "\n")
  
  if(shapiro_test$p.value < 0.05) {
    cat("→ Residuals are NOT normally distributed (p < 0.05) ✗\n")
  } else {
    cat("→ Residuals are approximately normally distributed (p ≥ 0.05) ✓\n")
  }
  
  # 3. Skewness by category
  cat("\n3. SKEWNESS (Distribution Shape):\n")
  skewness_stats <- data %>%
    group_by(!!sym(predictor_var)) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      skewness = skewness(!!sym(response_var), na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  print(skewness_stats)
  
  overall_skew <- skewness(data[[response_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
  cat("\nOverall skewness:", round(overall_skew, 2), "\n")
  
  # 4. Zero coverage
  cat("\n4. ZERO COVERAGE:\n")
  zero_stats <- data %>%
    group_by(!!sym(predictor_var)) %>%
    summarise(
      n_zeros = sum(!!sym(response_var) == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_zeros = round(100 * sum(!!sym(response_var) == 0, na.rm = TRUE) / n(), 2),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  print(zero_stats)
  
  overall_zeros <- sum(data[[response_var]] == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  overall_pct_zeros <- round(100 * overall_zeros / nrow(data), 2)
  cat("\nOverall: ", overall_zeros, " species (", overall_pct_zeros, "%) with zero coverage\n", sep = "")
  
  # 5. Cook's distance (influential points)
  cat("\n5. INFLUENTIAL OBSERVATIONS (Cook's Distance):\n")
  cd <- cooks.distance(model)
  influential <- which(cd > 4/length(cd))
  cat("Number of influential points (Cook's D > 4/n):", length(influential), "\n")
  cat("Percentage of influential points:", 
      round(100 * length(influential) / length(cd), 2), "%\n")
  
  # Return summary for table
  return(list(
    levene_f = levene_result$`F value`[1],
    levene_p = levene_result$`Pr(>F)`[1],
    shapiro_w = shapiro_test$statistic,
    shapiro_p = shapiro_test$p.value,
    overall_skewness = overall_skew,
    overall_zeros_pct = overall_pct_zeros,
    n_influential = length(influential),
    pct_influential = round(100 * length(influential) / length(cd), 2)
  ))
}

# Run comprehensive diagnostics for all three models
iucn_diag <- check_captain_beta_comprehensive(
  data = model_data,
  response_var = "IUCN_protection",
  predictor_var = "IUCN_status",
  model = iucn_beta,
  model_name = "CAPTAIN IUCN Model"
)

fuse_diag <- check_captain_beta_comprehensive(
  data = model_data,
  response_var = "FUSE_protection",
  predictor_var = "FUSE_score",
  model = fuse_beta,
  model_name = "CAPTAIN FUSE Model"
)

edge2_diag <- check_captain_beta_comprehensive(
  data = model_data,
  response_var = "EDGE2_protection",
  predictor_var = "EDGE2_score",
  model = edge2_beta,
  model_name = "CAPTAIN EDGE2 Model"
)

# Create comprehensive summary table

comprehensive_diagnostics <- data.frame(
  Model = c("CAPTAIN IUCN", "CAPTAIN FUSE", "CAPTAIN EDGE2"),
  Levene_F = c(iucn_diag$levene_f, fuse_diag$levene_f, edge2_diag$levene_f),
  Levene_p = c(iucn_diag$levene_p, fuse_diag$levene_p, edge2_diag$levene_p),
  Shapiro_W = c(iucn_diag$shapiro_w, fuse_diag$shapiro_w, edge2_diag$shapiro_w),
  Shapiro_p = c(iucn_diag$shapiro_p, fuse_diag$shapiro_p, edge2_diag$shapiro_p),
  Skewness = c(iucn_diag$overall_skewness, fuse_diag$overall_skewness, edge2_diag$overall_skewness),
  Zeros_pct = c(iucn_diag$overall_zeros_pct, fuse_diag$overall_zeros_pct, edge2_diag$overall_zeros_pct),
  Influential_pct = c(iucn_diag$pct_influential, fuse_diag$pct_influential, edge2_diag$pct_influential),
  Pseudo_R2 = c(iucn_r2, fuse_r2, edge2_r2),
  Significant = c("Yes (p<0.001)", "Yes (p=0.04)", "Yes (p<0.001)")
)

# Display with kable
kable(comprehensive_diagnostics, 
      format = "html",
      col.names = c("Model", "Levene F", "Levene p", "Shapiro W", "Shapiro p", 
                    "Skewness", "Zeros (%)", "Influential (%)", "Pseudo R²", "Result"),
      caption = "Comprehensive beta regression diagnostic summary for CAPTAIN validation models",
      digits = c(0, 2, 4, 4, 4, 2, 1, 1, 3, 0),
      align = c("l", "c", "c", "c", "c", "c", "c", "c", "c", "c")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"),
                full_width = FALSE,
                position = "center") %>%
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE, width = "150px") %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, background = "#f0f0f0") %>%
  column_spec(10, bold = TRUE, color = "#38AB38")
```

## Robustness of beta regressions to the boundary correction

Proportion of species with 0% or 100% protected range, and beta regression slopes under alternative boundary corrections.

```{r}
# Proportion of boundary values per dimension
boundary_summary <- purrr::map_dfr(c("IUCN", "FUSE", "EDGE2"), function(d) {
  y <- model_data[[paste0(d, "_protection")]] / 100
  tibble::tibble(Dimension = d,
                 n = length(y),
                 `Exactly 0 (%)` = round(100 * mean(y == 0), 1),
                 `Exactly 1 (%)` = round(100 * mean(y == 1), 1))
})
kable(boundary_summary, caption = "Species with 0% or 100% of their range protected")

# Beta regressions under alternative boundary corrections
sv <- function(y, n) (y * (n - 1) + 0.5) / n
corrections <- list(
  "S&V, n = 1000"  = function(y) sv(y, nrow(model_data)),
  "S&V, n = 100"   = function(y) sv(y, 100),
  "S&V, n = 10000" = function(y) sv(y, 10000),
  "Clamp 0.001"    = function(y) pmin(pmax(y, 0.001), 0.999),
  "Clamp 0.01"     = function(y) pmin(pmax(y, 0.01), 0.99)
)
dims <- c(IUCN = "IUCN_status", FUSE = "FUSE_score", EDGE2 = "EDGE2_score")

robustness <- purrr::map_dfr(names(dims), function(d) {
  y_raw <- model_data[[paste0(d, "_protection")]] / 100
  x     <- model_data[[dims[[d]]]]
  res <- purrr::imap_dfr(corrections, function(f, nm) {
    m <- betareg::betareg(f(y_raw) ~ x)
    s <- summary(m)$coefficients$mean["x", ]
    tibble::tibble(Dimension = d, Correction = nm, n = length(y_raw),
                   Slope = s[1], SE = s[2], p = s[4])
  })
  keep <- y_raw > 0 & y_raw < 1
  m <- betareg::betareg(y_raw[keep] ~ x[keep])
  s <- summary(m)$coefficients$mean[2, ]
  dplyr::bind_rows(res, tibble::tibble(Dimension = d, Correction = "Exclude 0 and 1",
                                       n = sum(keep), Slope = s[1], SE = s[2], p = s[4]))
})

# Format table for the Supplementary Materials (Table S7)
robustness_table <- robustness %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Correction = dplyr::recode(Correction,
                               "S&V, n = 1000"  = "S&V, n = 1,000",
                               "S&V, n = 10000" = "S&V, n = 10,000",
                               "Clamp 0.001"    = "Offset 0.001",
                               "Clamp 0.01"     = "Offset 0.01",
                               "Exclude 0 and 1" = "Excluding 0 and 1"),
    n     = format(n, big.mark = ","),
    Slope = sprintf("%.3f", Slope),
    SE    = sprintf("%.3f", SE),
    p     = ifelse(p < 0.001, "< 0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p))
  )

robustness_kable <- kable(robustness_table,
      format = "html",
      col.names = c("Dimension", "Correction", "n", "Slope", "SE", "p-value"),
      caption = "Robustness of beta regression results to the boundary correction",
      row.names = FALSE,
      align = c("l", "l", "c", "c", "c", "c")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"),
                full_width = FALSE,
                position = "center") %>%
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE, width = "90px") %>%
  column_spec(2, width = "160px") %>%
  column_spec(3:6, width = "80px") %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, background = "#f0f0f0") %>%
  row_spec(which(robustness_table$Correction == "S&V, n = 1,000"),
           background = "#f5f9ff") %>%
  collapse_rows(columns = 1, valign = "top") %>%
  footnote(general = "Slopes on the logit scale. S&V: Smithson & Verkuilen correction, y' = (y(n - 1) + 0.5)/n. Highlighted rows correspond to the correction used in the main analysis.",
           general_title = "Note:")

robustness_kable

# Save as PNG
save_kable(robustness_kable,
           file = here::here("R", "Outputs", "TableS3_beta_regression_robustness.png"),
           zoom = 2)

write.csv(robustness, here::here("R", "Outputs", "data_beta_regression_robustness.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```

## Species accumulation curve

```{r}
#======================
# FIG 2D: ENHANCED PROTECTION CURVES WITH ANNOTATIONS AND INSET
#======================

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# --- 1. Prepare data ---
accum_data <- protected_fractions %>%
  mutate(
    IUCN = IUCN * 100,
    FUSE = FUSE * 100,
    EDGE2 = EDGE2 * 100
  )

# --- 2. Create sorted curves ---
curve_iucn <- tibble(
  rank = 1:sum(!is.na(accum_data$IUCN)),
  protection = sort(accum_data$IUCN[!is.na(accum_data$IUCN)]),
  index = "IUCN"
)

curve_fuse <- tibble(
  rank = 1:sum(!is.na(accum_data$FUSE)),
  protection = sort(accum_data$FUSE[!is.na(accum_data$FUSE)]),
  index = "FUSE"
)

curve_edge2 <- tibble(
  rank = 1:sum(!is.na(accum_data$EDGE2)),
  protection = sort(accum_data$EDGE2[!is.na(accum_data$EDGE2)]),
  index = "EDGE2"
)

curve_data <- bind_rows(curve_iucn, curve_fuse, curve_edge2)

# --- 3. Calculate statistics ---
n_species <- nrow(accum_data)

# Species reaching each threshold (for annotations)
thresholds <- c(1, 10, 30, 50)

stats_list <- lapply(thresholds, function(t) {
  data.frame(
    threshold = t,
    IUCN_n = sum(accum_data$IUCN >= t, na.rm = TRUE),
    FUSE_n = sum(accum_data$FUSE >= t, na.rm = TRUE),
    EDGE2_n = sum(accum_data$EDGE2 >= t, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      IUCN_pct = round(IUCN_n / n_species * 100, 1),
      FUSE_pct = round(FUSE_n / n_species * 100, 1),
      EDGE2_pct = round(EDGE2_n / n_species * 100, 1)
    )
})
threshold_stats <- bind_rows(stats_list)

# --- 4. Create CUMULATIVE protection bins for inset ---
# Species reaching AT LEAST each threshold (cumulative, increasing order)
cumulative_bins <- data.frame(
  threshold = c("≥50%", "≥30%", "≥10%", "≥1%"),
  IUCN = c(
    sum(accum_data$IUCN >= 50, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(accum_data$IUCN >= 30, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(accum_data$IUCN >= 10, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(accum_data$IUCN >= 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  FUSE = c(
    sum(accum_data$FUSE >= 50, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(accum_data$FUSE >= 30, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(accum_data$FUSE >= 10, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(accum_data$FUSE >= 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  EDGE2 = c(
    sum(accum_data$EDGE2 >= 50, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(accum_data$EDGE2 >= 30, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(accum_data$EDGE2 >= 10, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(accum_data$EDGE2 >= 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(IUCN, FUSE, EDGE2), names_to = "index", values_to = "n") %>%
  mutate(pct = n / n_species * 100)

# Order so bars increase left to right
cumulative_bins$threshold <- factor(cumulative_bins$threshold, 
                                     levels = c("≥50%", "≥30%", "≥10%", "≥1%"))

# --- 5. Create CUMULATIVE inset barplot ---
inset_plot <- ggplot(cumulative_bins, aes(x = threshold, y = pct, fill = index)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("IUCN" = "#E41A1C", "FUSE" = "#377EB8", "EDGE2" = "#984EA3")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), breaks = seq(0, 100, 25)) +
  labs(
    x = "Protection threshold",
    y = "% of species"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("grey80", 0.3), color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("grey80", 0.3), color = NA),
    plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
  )

# --- Find x positions where IUCN curve crosses each threshold ---
x_at_1 <- which(curve_iucn$protection >= 1)[1]
x_at_10 <- which(curve_iucn$protection >= 10)[1]
x_at_30 <- which(curve_iucn$protection >= 30)[1]
x_at_50 <- which(curve_iucn$protection >= 50)[1]

# Add x offset to move 10%, 30%, 50% annotations closer to red line
x_offset <- 50

# Get y values of IUCN curve at those positions (plus offset for label above)
y_offset <- 25

y_at_1 <- curve_iucn$protection[x_at_1] + 15
y_at_10 <- curve_iucn$protection[x_at_10 + x_offset] + y_offset
y_at_30 <- curve_iucn$protection[x_at_30 + x_offset] + y_offset
y_at_50 <- curve_iucn$protection[x_at_50 + x_offset] + y_offset

# Calculate percentages for <1%
pct_below1_iucn <- round((n_species - threshold_stats$IUCN_n[1]) / n_species * 100, 1)
pct_below1_fuse <- round((n_species - threshold_stats$FUSE_n[1]) / n_species * 100, 1)
pct_below1_edge2 <- round((n_species - threshold_stats$EDGE2_n[1]) / n_species * 100, 1)

# --- 6. Create main plot ---
main_plot <- ggplot(curve_data, aes(x = rank, y = protection, color = index)) +
  # L-shape <1% (red) - outermost
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0, xmax = x_at_1, ymin = 0, ymax = 100, 
           fill = "#d73027", alpha = 0.3) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = x_at_1, xmax = n_species, ymin = 0, ymax = 1, 
           fill = "#d73027", alpha = 0.3) +
  # L-shape 1-10% (orange)
  annotate("rect", xmin = x_at_1, xmax = x_at_10, ymin = 1, ymax = 100, 
           fill = "#fc8d59", alpha = 0.3) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = x_at_10, xmax = n_species, ymin = 1, ymax = 10, 
           fill = "#fc8d59", alpha = 0.3) +
  # L-shape 10-30% (yellow)
  annotate("rect", xmin = x_at_10, xmax = x_at_30, ymin = 10, ymax = 100, 
           fill = "#fee090", alpha = 0.3) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = x_at_30, xmax = n_species, ymin = 10, ymax = 30, 
           fill = "#fee090", alpha = 0.3) +
  # L-shape 30-50% (light blue)
  annotate("rect", xmin = x_at_30, xmax = x_at_50, ymin = 30, ymax = 100, 
           fill = "#e0f3f8", alpha = 0.3) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = x_at_50, xmax = n_species, ymin = 30, ymax = 50, 
           fill = "#e0f3f8", alpha = 0.3) +
  # Rectangle >50% (blue) - innermost
  annotate("rect", xmin = x_at_50, xmax = n_species, ymin = 50, ymax = 100, 
           fill = "#91bfdb", alpha = 0.3) +
  # Reference lines at key thresholds
  geom_hline(yintercept = 10, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 30, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 50, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
  # Curves
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("IUCN" = "#E41A1C", "FUSE" = "#377EB8", "EDGE2" = "#984EA3"),
    breaks = c("IUCN", "FUSE", "EDGE2"),
    name = "Prioritisation"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.02, 0), breaks = seq(0, 100, 10), limits = c(0, 130)) +
  labs(
    x = "Species rank (ordered by % range protected)",
    y = "% range protected"
  ) +
  # --- Annotation <1% threshold ---
annotate("label", x = x_at_1, y = y_at_1, 
         label = paste0("<1%\nIUCN: ", pct_below1_iucn, "%\nFUSE: ", pct_below1_fuse, "%\nEDGE2: ", pct_below1_edge2, "%"),
         size = 3, hjust = 0.5, color = "grey20", lineheight = 0.9,
         fill = "#d73027", alpha = 0.3, label.size = 0) +

# --- Annotation ≥10% threshold ---
annotate("label", x = x_at_10 + x_offset, y = y_at_10, 
         label = paste0("≥10%\nIUCN: ", threshold_stats$IUCN_pct[2], "%\nFUSE: ", threshold_stats$FUSE_pct[2], "%\nEDGE2: ", threshold_stats$EDGE2_pct[2], "%"),
         size = 3, hjust = 0.5, color = "grey20", lineheight = 0.9,
         fill = "#fc8d59", alpha = 0.3, label.size = 0) +

# --- Annotation ≥30% threshold ---
annotate("label", x = x_at_30 + x_offset, y = y_at_30, 
         label = paste0("≥30%\nIUCN: ", threshold_stats$IUCN_pct[3], "%\nFUSE: ", threshold_stats$FUSE_pct[3], "%\nEDGE2: ", threshold_stats$EDGE2_pct[3], "%"),
         size = 3, hjust = 0.5, color = "grey20", lineheight = 0.9,
         fill = "#fee090", alpha = 0.3, label.size = 0) +

# --- Annotation ≥50% threshold ---
annotate("label", x = x_at_50 + x_offset, y = y_at_50, 
         label = paste0("≥50%\nIUCN: ", threshold_stats$IUCN_pct[4], "%\nFUSE: ", threshold_stats$FUSE_pct[4], "%\nEDGE2: ", threshold_stats$EDGE2_pct[4], "%"),
         size = 3, hjust = 0.5, color = "grey20", lineheight = 0.9,
         fill = "#91bfdb", alpha = 0.3, label.size = 0) +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.title.position = "top",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.margin = margin(5, 30, 5, 5)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off")

# --- 7. Add inset to main plot ---
fig2d <- main_plot +
  inset_element(
    inset_plot,
    left = 0.58, right = 0.98,
    bottom = 0.02, top = 0.38
  )
```

```{r}
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0, size = 12)

    labs(title = paste0("(", label, ")"))
```

```{r}
# Create a function to add labels (A), (B), etc.
add_panel_labels <- function(plot, label) {
  plot + 
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0, size = 12)
    ) +
    labs(title = paste0("(", label, ")"))
}
```

```{r}
# FUSE

  filter(Priority > 0.9)

fuse_high_cells <- nrow(CAPTAIN2_FUSE_high)
fuse_percent <- round((fuse_high_cells / fuse_total_cells) * 100, 1)

# EDGE2

  filter(Priority > 0.9)

edge2_high_cells <- nrow(CAPTAIN2_EDGE2_high)

#Mean nearest neighbor for high priority grid cells:

# Function to calculate Mean Nearest Neighbor Distance
calculate_mnn <- function(sf_high_priority) {
  # Get centroids and convert to coordinates
  coords <- st_coordinates(st_centroid(sf_high_priority))
  
  # Create a bounding box for the window
  bbox <- st_bbox(sf_high_priority)
  
  # Create observation window
  window <- owin(xrange = c(bbox["xmin"], bbox["xmax"]),
                 yrange = c(bbox["ymin"], bbox["ymax"]))
  
  # Create point pattern object
  ppp_obj <- ppp(coords[,1], coords[,2], window = window)
  
  # Calculate mean nearest neighbor distance
  mnn <- mean(nndist(ppp_obj))
  
  # Calculate standard deviation for context
  mnn_sd <- sd(nndist(ppp_obj))
  
  return(list(mean = mnn, sd = mnn_sd))
}

# Calculate for each index
iucn_mnn <- calculate_mnn(CAPTAIN2_IUCN_high)
fuse_mnn <- calculate_mnn(CAPTAIN2_FUSE_high)
edge2_mnn <- calculate_mnn(CAPTAIN2_EDGE2_high)

# Create summary data frame
mnn_summary <- data.frame(
  Index = c("IUCN", "FUSE", "EDGE2"),
  N_cells = c(iucn_high_cells, fuse_high_cells, edge2_high_cells),
  Percent = c(iucn_percent, fuse_percent, edge2_percent),
  MNN_mean = c(iucn_mnn$mean, fuse_mnn$mean, edge2_mnn$mean),
  MNN_sd = c(iucn_mnn$sd, fuse_mnn$sd, edge2_mnn$sd)
)

knitr::kable(mnn_summary, digits = 1,
             col.names = c("Dimension", "High-priority cells", "Percent", "Mean NND (m)", "SD NND (m)"),
             caption = "High-priority cells (priority > 0.9) per dimension and their spatial clustering (mean nearest-neighbour distance, NND)")
```

```{r}
high_priority_IUCN <- CAPTAIN2_IUCN_sf[CAPTAIN2_IUCN_sf$Priority > 0.9, ]
```

# Congruence tests

```{r}
# Statistical congruence analysis following the methods section
# First, extract priority values for the comparison
priority_threshold <- 0.9

# Planning units: all cells where at least one of the 1,000 species occurs
tif_files <- list.files(here::here("R", "Data", "tif files continental"), pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE)
terra::terraOptions(progress = 0)
species_stack <- terra::rast(tif_files)
species_richness <- terra::app(species_stack > 0, sum, na.rm = TRUE)
planning_units <- which(terra::values(species_richness)[, 1] > 0)

# Align the three prioritisations on the same planning units (PUID = cell number)
priorities_pu <- data.frame(PUID = planning_units) %>%
  left_join(CAPTAIN2_FUSE_data %>% dplyr::select(PUID, Priority_FUSE = Priority), by = "PUID") %>%
  left_join(CAPTAIN2_EDGE2_data %>% dplyr::select(PUID, Priority_EDGE2 = Priority), by = "PUID") %>%
  left_join(CAPTAIN2_IUCN_data %>% dplyr::select(PUID, Priority_IUCN = Priority), by = "PUID") %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("Priority"), ~ tidyr::replace_na(.x, 0)))


# Create binary vectors for high-priority areas (>0.9)
fuse_high <- priorities_pu$Priority_FUSE > priority_threshold
edge2_high <- priorities_pu$Priority_EDGE2 > priority_threshold
iucn_high <- priorities_pu$Priority_IUCN > priority_threshold

# Calculate observed overlaps
observed_fuse_edge2 <- sum(fuse_high & edge2_high)
observed_fuse_iucn <- sum(fuse_high & iucn_high)
observed_edge2_iucn <- sum(edge2_high & iucn_high)
observed_all_three <- sum(fuse_high & edge2_high & iucn_high)

# Calculate minimum high-priority cells for each comparison
min_fuse_edge2 <- min(sum(fuse_high), sum(edge2_high))
min_fuse_iucn <- min(sum(fuse_high), sum(iucn_high))
min_edge2_iucn <- min(sum(edge2_high), sum(iucn_high))

# Calculate percentage overlaps (conservative estimate)
overlap_fuse_edge2 <- (observed_fuse_edge2 / min_fuse_edge2) * 100
overlap_fuse_iucn <- (observed_fuse_iucn / min_fuse_iucn) * 100
overlap_edge2_iucn <- (observed_edge2_iucn / min_edge2_iucn) * 100

# Randomization test function
randomization_test <- function(index1_high, index2_high, n_permutations = 999) {
  observed_overlap <- sum(index1_high & index2_high)
  min_cells <- min(sum(index1_high), sum(index2_high))
  observed_percentage <- (observed_overlap / min_cells) * 100
  
  # Generate random overlaps
  random_overlaps <- replicate(n_permutations, {
    # Randomly shuffle the spatial distribution of index1
    shuffled_index1 <- sample(index1_high)
    random_overlap <- sum(shuffled_index1 & index2_high)
    (random_overlap / min_cells) * 100
  })
  
  # Position of the observed value within the null distribution
  prop_greater <- mean(random_overlaps > observed_percentage)
  prop_less <- mean(random_overlaps < observed_percentage)
  
  # Calculate p-value (one-sided, in the direction of the observed deviation)
  if (observed_percentage > mean(random_overlaps)) {
    p_value <- (sum(random_overlaps >= observed_percentage) + 1) / (n_permutations + 1)
  } else {
    p_value <- (sum(random_overlaps <= observed_percentage) + 1) / (n_permutations + 1)
  }
  
  return(list(
    observed_percentage = observed_percentage,
    expected_percentage = mean(random_overlaps),
    null_range = range(random_overlaps),
    prop_greater = prop_greater,
    prop_less = prop_less,
    p_value = p_value,
    random_overlaps = random_overlaps
  ))
}

# Perform randomization tests

set.seed(2025)

# FUSE vs EDGE2
test_fuse_edge2 <- randomization_test(fuse_high, edge2_high)

# FUSE vs IUCN
test_fuse_iucn <- randomization_test(fuse_high, iucn_high)

# EDGE2 vs IUCN
test_edge2_iucn <- randomization_test(edge2_high, iucn_high)

# Create a summary table
congruence_results <- data.frame(
  Comparison = c("FUSE vs EDGE2", "FUSE vs IUCN", "EDGE2 vs IUCN"),
  Observed_Overlap_Percent = c(test_fuse_edge2$observed_percentage,
                               test_fuse_iucn$observed_percentage,
                               test_edge2_iucn$observed_percentage),
  Expected_Overlap_Percent = c(test_fuse_edge2$expected_percentage,
                               test_fuse_iucn$expected_percentage,
                               test_edge2_iucn$expected_percentage),
  Null_Min_Percent = c(test_fuse_edge2$null_range[1],
                       test_fuse_iucn$null_range[1],
                       test_edge2_iucn$null_range[1]),
  Null_Max_Percent = c(test_fuse_edge2$null_range[2],
                       test_fuse_iucn$null_range[2],
                       test_edge2_iucn$null_range[2]),
  Prop_Random_Greater = c(test_fuse_edge2$prop_greater,
                          test_fuse_iucn$prop_greater,
                          test_edge2_iucn$prop_greater),
  Prop_Random_Less = c(test_fuse_edge2$prop_less,
                       test_fuse_iucn$prop_less,
                       test_edge2_iucn$prop_less),
  P_Value = c(test_fuse_edge2$p_value,
              test_fuse_iucn$p_value,
              test_edge2_iucn$p_value),
  Significance = c(
    ifelse(test_fuse_edge2$p_value < 0.001, "***",
           ifelse(test_fuse_edge2$p_value < 0.01, "**",
                  ifelse(test_fuse_edge2$p_value < 0.05, "*", "ns"))),
    ifelse(test_fuse_iucn$p_value < 0.001, "***",
           ifelse(test_fuse_iucn$p_value < 0.01, "**",
                  ifelse(test_fuse_iucn$p_value < 0.05, "*", "ns"))),
    ifelse(test_edge2_iucn$p_value < 0.001, "***",
           ifelse(test_edge2_iucn$p_value < 0.01, "**",
                  ifelse(test_edge2_iucn$p_value < 0.05, "*", "ns")))
  )
)

# Formatted table (Table S4)
n_high <- c(FUSE = sum(fuse_high), EDGE2 = sum(edge2_high), IUCN = sum(iucn_high))

congruence_table <- data.frame(
  Comparison = c("FUSE vs EDGE2", "FUSE vs IUCN", "EDGE2 vs IUCN"),
  Cells = c(paste(format(n_high["FUSE"], big.mark = ","), "/", format(n_high["EDGE2"], big.mark = ",")),
            paste(format(n_high["FUSE"], big.mark = ","), "/", format(n_high["IUCN"], big.mark = ",")),
            paste(format(n_high["EDGE2"], big.mark = ","), "/", format(n_high["IUCN"], big.mark = ","))),
  Observed = sprintf("%.2f", congruence_results$Observed_Overlap_Percent),
  Expected = sprintf("%.2f", congruence_results$Expected_Overlap_Percent),
  Null_range = sprintf("%.2f–%.2f", congruence_results$Null_Min_Percent, congruence_results$Null_Max_Percent),
  Greater = sprintf("%.3f", congruence_results$Prop_Random_Greater),
  Less = sprintf("%.3f", congruence_results$Prop_Random_Less),
  P = sprintf("%.3f", congruence_results$P_Value)
)

congruence_kable <- kable(congruence_table,
      format = "html",
      col.names = c("Comparison", "High-priority cells", "Observed overlap (%)",
                    "Expected overlap (%)", "Null range (%)",
                    "Proportion random > observed", "Proportion random < observed", "p-value"),
      caption = "Spatial congruence of high-priority areas (priority > 0.9) between dimensions",
      row.names = FALSE,
      align = c("l", "c", "c", "c", "c", "c", "c", "c")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"),
                full_width = FALSE,
                position = "center") %>%
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE, width = "120px") %>%
  column_spec(2:8, width = "110px") %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, background = "#f0f0f0") %>%
  footnote(general = paste0("Overlap is expressed as a percentage of the smaller set of high-priority cells. Expected overlap and null range are the mean and range of 999 randomisations, in which the high-priority cells of the first dimension were randomly redistributed across the ",
                            format(nrow(priorities_pu), big.mark = ","),
                            " planning units. The p-value is (number of randomised overlaps at least as large as the observed overlap + 1)/(999 + 1)."),
           general_title = "Note:")

congruence_kable

save_kable(congruence_kable,
           file = here::here("R", "Outputs", "TableS4_congruence_randomisation.png"),
           zoom = 2)

write.csv(congruence_results, here::here("R", "Outputs", "data_congruence_randomisation.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```

# Sensitivity to the protection target

CAPTAIN predictions at protection targets of 5%, 20% and 30% of planning units, obtained with the models trained at 10% (50 predictions per target and dimension; D. Silvestro, October 2026). Raw outputs (`Python/captain_budget_sensitivity_runs.zip`) are summarised by `Python/Summarise CAPTAIN 2 budget sensitivity runs.py`, which reads them directly from the zip archive, into `R/Data/CAPTAIN2_budget_sensitivity_priorities.csv` (priority = frequency of selection across the 50 predictions). As these predictions come from models trained at a 10% target, they may be less optimal than solutions from models trained at each target.

## Maps of high-priority areas across protection targets

Each cell is coloured by the smallest protection target at which it is a high-priority area (priority \> 0.9).

```{r}
budget_priorities <- read.csv(here::here("R", "Data", "CAPTAIN2_budget_sensitivity_priorities.csv"),
                              check.names = FALSE)

# Grid cell coordinates (PUID = cell number of the 0.5-degree grid)
grid_coords <- as.data.frame(coordinates(r))
names(grid_coords) <- c("Longitude", "Latitude")
grid_coords$PUID <- 1:nrow(grid_coords)

# Priorities at all four targets for each dimension, aligned by PUID
priorities_targets <- data.frame(PUID = grid_coords$PUID) %>%
  left_join(budget_priorities, by = "PUID") %>%
  left_join(CAPTAIN2_IUCN_data %>% dplyr::select(PUID, IUCN_0.1 = Priority), by = "PUID") %>%
  left_join(CAPTAIN2_FUSE_data %>% dplyr::select(PUID, FUSE_0.1 = Priority), by = "PUID") %>%
  left_join(CAPTAIN2_EDGE2_data %>% dplyr::select(PUID, EDGE2_0.1 = Priority), by = "PUID") %>%
  mutate(across(-PUID, ~ tidyr::replace_na(.x, 0))) %>%
  left_join(grid_coords, by = "PUID")

targets <- c("0.05", "0.1", "0.2", "0.3")
target_labels <- c("5%", "10%", "20%", "30%")
target_colours <- c("5%" = "#08306B", "10%" = "#2171B5", "20%" = "#6BAED6", "30%" = "#C6DBEF")

# Smallest target at which each cell is a high-priority area (priority > 0.9)
first_target <- function(dimension, threshold = 0.9) {
  high <- sapply(targets, function(t) priorities_targets[[paste0(dimension, "_", t)]] > threshold)
  first <- apply(high, 1, function(x) if (any(x)) target_labels[which(x)[1]] else NA_character_)
  factor(first, levels = target_labels)
}

budget_maps_data <- lapply(c("IUCN", "FUSE", "EDGE2"), function(dimension) {
  priorities_targets %>%
    mutate(first_target = first_target(dimension)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(first_target), !is.na(Longitude), !is.na(Latitude)) %>%
    arrange(desc(first_target)) %>%
    st_as_sf(coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = crs(r, asText = TRUE)) %>%
    st_transform(crs = mcbryde_thomas_2)
})
names(budget_maps_data) <- c("IUCN", "FUSE", "EDGE2")

# Number of high-priority cells first selected at each target
budget_counts <- sapply(budget_maps_data, function(x) table(x$first_target))
knitr::kable(budget_counts, caption = "Number of high-priority cells (priority > 0.9) by smallest protection target")

world_projected_budget <- st_transform(world, crs = mcbryde_thomas_2)

globe_border_budget <- st_polygon(list(rbind(c(-180, -90), c(-180, 90), c(180, 90), c(180, -90), c(-180, -90)))) %>%
  st_sfc(crs = 4326) %>%
  smoothr::densify(max_distance = 0.5) %>%
  st_transform(crs = mcbryde_thomas_2)

budget_map <- function(data, title) {
  ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = data, aes(color = first_target), size = 0.5, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_sf(data = world_projected_budget, fill = "lightgrey", color = "lightgrey", linewidth = 0.1) +
    geom_sf(data = globe_border_budget, fill = NA, color = "lightgrey", linewidth = 0.5) +
    scale_color_manual(values = target_colours, drop = FALSE,
                       name = "Smallest protection target at which the cell is a high-priority area",
                       guide = guide_legend(title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5,
                                            override.aes = list(size = 4, alpha = 1))) +
    coord_sf(crs = mcbryde_thomas_2, datum = NA) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.text = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
}

budget_maps <- ggpubr::ggarrange(
  budget_map(budget_maps_data$IUCN, "IUCN"),
  budget_map(budget_maps_data$FUSE, "FUSE"),
  budget_map(budget_maps_data$EDGE2, "EDGE2"),
  ncol = 1, nrow = 3,
  common.legend = TRUE, legend = "bottom"
)

ggsave(here::here("R", "Outputs", "FigS16_protection_target_sensitivity_maps.png"),
       plot = budget_maps, width = 8, height = 14, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

```

## Species protection, nestedness and congruence across protection targets

Species-level protection at each target is the fraction of each species' range protected, averaged across the 50 predictions (10%: `CAPTAIN2_protected_range_fractions_2ndrun.rds`; 5%, 20% and 30%: `R/Data/CAPTAIN2_budget_sensitivity_protected_range.csv`, species in the same order). Nestedness is the percentage of high-priority cells (priority \> 0.9) at a given target that remain high priority at the next larger target, and congruence is the percentage of cells that are high priority in at least one dimension that are high priority in all three, as in the main analysis.

```{r}
budget_range <- read.csv(here::here("R", "Data", "CAPTAIN2_budget_sensitivity_protected_range.csv"))

high_cells <- function(dimension, target) {
  priorities_targets$PUID[priorities_targets[[paste0(dimension, "_", target)]] > 0.9]
}

target_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("IUCN", "FUSE", "EDGE2"), function(dimension) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(targets), function(i) {
    target <- targets[i]
    fraction <- if (target == "0.1") protected_fractions[[dimension]] else budget_range[[paste0(dimension, "_", target)]]
    top_class <- budget_range[[paste0(dimension, "_class")]] == 0
    cells <- high_cells(dimension, target)
    retained <- if (i < length(targets)) 100 * mean(cells %in% high_cells(dimension, targets[i + 1])) else NA
    data.frame(Dimension = dimension,
               Target = target_labels[i],
               Mean_protected = 100 * mean(fraction),
               Top_class_protected = 100 * mean(fraction[top_class]),
               No_protection = sum(fraction == 0),
               High_cells = length(cells),
               Retained = retained)
  }))
}))

target_congruence <- data.frame(
  Target = target_labels,
  Shared_all = sapply(targets, function(target) {
    iucn <- high_cells("IUCN", target)
    fuse <- high_cells("FUSE", target)
    edge2 <- high_cells("EDGE2", target)
    100 * length(Reduce(intersect, list(iucn, fuse, edge2))) / length(Reduce(union, list(iucn, fuse, edge2)))
  })
)

target_table <- target_summary %>%
  left_join(target_congruence, by = "Target") %>%
  mutate(Mean_protected = sprintf("%.1f", Mean_protected),
         Top_class_protected = sprintf("%.1f", Top_class_protected),
         High_cells = format(High_cells, big.mark = ","),
         Retained = ifelse(is.na(Retained), "-", sprintf("%.1f", Retained)),
         Shared_all = sprintf("%.1f", Shared_all))

target_kable <- kable(target_table,
      format = "html",
      col.names = c("Dimension", "Protection target", "Mean range protected (%)",
                    "Range protected, highest class (%)", "Species with no range protected",
                    "High-priority cells", "Retained at the next target (%)",
                    "Shared by all three dimensions (%)"),
      caption = "Species protection, nestedness and congruence of priorities across protection targets",
      row.names = FALSE,
      align = c("l", "c", "c", "c", "c", "c", "c", "c")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"),
                full_width = FALSE,
                position = "center") %>%
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE, width = "90px") %>%
  column_spec(2:8, width = "110px") %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, background = "#f0f0f0") %>%
  collapse_rows(columns = 1, valign = "top") %>%
  footnote(general = "Range protected is the fraction of each species' range within selected cells, averaged across the 50 predictions. The highest class is Critically Endangered for IUCN and the highest score class for FUSE and EDGE2. High-priority cells have a priority > 0.9. Shared by all three dimensions: percentage of cells that are high priority in at least one dimension that are high priority in all three. Predictions at 5%, 20% and 30% come from the models trained at 10%.",
           general_title = "Note:")

target_kable

save_kable(target_kable,
           file = here::here("R", "Outputs", "TableS9_protection_target_sensitivity.png"),
           zoom = 2)

write.csv(target_summary %>% left_join(target_congruence, by = "Target"),
          here::here("R", "Outputs", "data_protection_target_sensitivity.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```

# Relationship with fishing effort

## Bivariate maps

```{r}
# Load your CAPTAIN data
IUCN_data <- CAPTAIN2_IUCN_data_nonzero  # Assuming this exists from your previous code
FUSE_data <- CAPTAIN2_FUSE_data_nonzero  # Assuming this exists from your previous code
EDGE2_data <- CAPTAIN2_EDGE2_data_nonzero # Assuming this exists from your previous code

# Process and prepare the data function
process_bivariate_data <- function(priority_data, fishing_data, min_priority = 0) {
  # Filter for cells with priority > min_priority
  priority_data_filtered <- priority_data %>%
    filter(Priority > min_priority)
  
  # Prepare fishing data
  fishing_data <- fishing_data %>%
    rename(Longitude = lon_05deg, Latitude = lat_05deg, FishingHours = predicted_fishing_hours)
  
  # Join datasets
  combined_data <- priority_data_filtered %>%
    left_join(fishing_data, by = c("Longitude", "Latitude"))
  
  # Handle NAs in fishing hours (replace with 0)
  combined_data$FishingHours[is.na(combined_data$FishingHours)] <- 0
  
  # Normalize priorities to 0-1 range and log transform fishing hours
  combined_data <- combined_data %>%
    mutate(
      Priority_Norm = Priority, # Assuming already in 0-1 range
      # Log transform fishing hours to better handle skewed distribution
      FishingHours_Log = log1p(FishingHours),
      # Normalize log fishing hours
      FishingHours_Norm = (FishingHours_Log - min(FishingHours_Log, na.rm = TRUE)) /
                         (max(FishingHours_Log, na.rm = TRUE) - min(FishingHours_Log, na.rm = TRUE))
    )
  
  # Set projection
  mcbryde_thomas_2 <- "+proj=mbt_s"
  
  # Transform to sf object
  data_sf <- st_as_sf(combined_data, coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326) %>%
    st_transform(crs = mcbryde_thomas_2)
  
  return(data_sf)
}

# Process the three datasets with fishing data (only cells with Priority > 0)
iucn_fishing_sf <- process_bivariate_data(IUCN_data, aggregated_data, min_priority = 0)
fuse_fishing_sf <- process_bivariate_data(FUSE_data, aggregated_data, min_priority = 0)
edge2_fishing_sf <- process_bivariate_data(EDGE2_data, aggregated_data, min_priority = 0)

# Create color palette - using the PurpleOr scheme
create_bivariate_palette <- function() {
  map_pal_raw <- bi_pal(pal = 'PurpleOr', dim = 4, preview = FALSE)
  map_pal_mtx <- matrix(map_pal_raw, nrow = 4, ncol = 4)
  map_pal_mtx[3, ] <- colorspace::lighten(map_pal_mtx[3, ], .1)
  map_pal_mtx[2, ] <- colorspace::lighten(map_pal_mtx[2, ], .2)
  map_pal_mtx[1, ] <- colorspace::lighten(map_pal_mtx[1, ], .3)
  map_pal_mtx[ , 3] <- colorspace::lighten(map_pal_mtx[ , 3], .1)
  map_pal_mtx[ , 2] <- colorspace::lighten(map_pal_mtx[ , 2], .2)
  map_pal_mtx[ , 1] <- colorspace::lighten(map_pal_mtx[ , 1], .3)
  map_pal_mtx[1, 1] <- '#ffffee'
  map_pal <- as.vector(map_pal_mtx) %>% setNames(names(map_pal_raw))
  return(map_pal)
}

map_pal <- create_bivariate_palette()

# Color mapping function
get_color <- function(priority, fishing) {
  priority_class <- cut(priority, breaks = c(-Inf, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, Inf), labels = 1:4)
  fishing_class <- cut(fishing, breaks = c(-Inf, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, Inf), labels = 1:4)
  return(map_pal[(as.numeric(fishing_class)-1)*4 + as.numeric(priority_class)])
}

# Apply colors to the datasets
iucn_fishing_sf$bivariate_color <- mapply(get_color,
                                          iucn_fishing_sf$Priority_Norm,
                                          iucn_fishing_sf$FishingHours_Norm)

fuse_fishing_sf$bivariate_color <- mapply(get_color,
                                          fuse_fishing_sf$Priority_Norm,
                                          fuse_fishing_sf$FishingHours_Norm)

edge2_fishing_sf$bivariate_color <- mapply(get_color,
                                          edge2_fishing_sf$Priority_Norm,
                                          edge2_fishing_sf$FishingHours_Norm)

# Get world map and project
world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")
mcbryde_thomas_2 <- "+proj=mbt_s"
world_projected <- st_transform(world, crs = mcbryde_thomas_2)

# Create globe border
lon_points <- rep(c(-180, 180), each = 100)
lat_points <- c(seq(-90, 90, length.out = 100), seq(90, -90, length.out = 100))
globe_outline <- data.frame(lon = lon_points, lat = lat_points) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_combine() %>%
  st_cast("POLYGON") %>%
  st_transform(crs = mcbryde_thomas_2)

# Function to create individual bivariate maps with labels and titles
create_bivariate_map <- function(data_sf, title) {
  ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = data_sf, aes(color = bivariate_color), size = 0.1, alpha = 1) +
    geom_sf(data = world_projected, fill = "lightgray", color = "lightgray") +
    geom_sf(data = globe_outline, fill = NA, color = "grey70", size = 0.5) +
    scale_color_identity() +
    coord_sf() +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = title) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold.italic", hjust = 0),
      plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5, "mm")
    )
}

# Create the three maps with labels and titles
iucn_plot <- create_bivariate_map(iucn_fishing_sf,
  "(A) IUCN Red List threat status")
fuse_plot <- create_bivariate_map(fuse_fishing_sf,
  "(B) Functionally Unique Specialised and Endangered")
edge2_plot <- create_bivariate_map(edge2_fishing_sf,
  "(C) Evolutionary Distinct and Globally Endangered")

# Create a larger legend for better visibility
larger_legend <- bi_legend(pal = map_pal, dim = 4,
                          xlab = 'Conservation\npriority',
                          ylab = 'Fishing\neffort',
                          size = 4) +  # Increased from 3 to 4 for bigger legend
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),  # Reduced from 12 to 10
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),  # Reduced from 10 to 8
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),  # Reduced from 12 to 10
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10, "mm")
  )

# Create layout matrix: 3 rows, 2 columns
# Column 1: maps (wider)
# Column 2: empty, legend (middle row), empty
layout_matrix <- rbind(
  c(1, NA),      # Row 1: Map A, empty
  c(2, 4),       # Row 2: Map B, legend
  c(3, NA)       # Row 3: Map C, empty
)

# Arrange all plots together (no auto-display)
combined_plot <- gridExtra::arrangeGrob(
  iucn_plot,
  fuse_plot,
  edge2_plot,
  larger_legend,
  layout_matrix = layout_matrix,
  heights = c(1, 1, 1),      # Equal height for all three map rows
  widths = c(3, 1)           # Maps take 3/4 width, legend takes 1/4
)

# Save with dimensions better suited for A4 portrait
ggsave(here::here("R","Outputs", "Fig5_priorities_fishing_bivariate.png"),
       combined_plot, width = 8.3, height = 11, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

## Ecoregion analysis

```{r}
library(ggrepel)
library(ggsci)
library(cowplot)
library(ggpubr)

# ---- Fishing data processing ----
fishing_sf <- aggregated_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(lon_05deg), !is.na(lat_05deg), !is.na(predicted_fishing_hours)) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon_05deg", "lat_05deg"), crs = 4326)

st_crs(fishing_sf) <- st_crs(meow_ecos)

fishing_with_ecoregion <- st_join(fishing_sf, meow_ecos %>% dplyr::select(ECOREGION, REALM))

ecoregion_fishing_stats <- fishing_with_ecoregion %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(ECOREGION, REALM) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_fishing_hours = mean(predicted_fishing_hours, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_fishing_hours = median(predicted_fishing_hours, na.rm = TRUE),
    fishing_q05 = quantile(predicted_fishing_hours, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    fishing_q95 = quantile(predicted_fishing_hours, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
    fishing_cells = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ECOREGION)) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_fishing_hours))

# ---- Priority data processing ----
coords <- as.data.frame(coordinates(r))
names(coords) <- c("Longitude", "Latitude")
coords$PUID <- 1:nrow(coords)

combined_data <- CAPTAIN2_EDGE2_data %>%
  rename(Priority_EDGE2 = Priority) %>%
  left_join(CAPTAIN2_FUSE_data %>% dplyr::select(PUID, Priority) %>%
              rename(Priority_FUSE = Priority), by = "PUID") %>%
  left_join(CAPTAIN2_IUCN_data %>% dplyr::select(PUID, Priority) %>%
              rename(Priority_IUCN = Priority), by = "PUID") %>%
  left_join(coords, by = "PUID")

iucn_sf <- combined_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(Longitude), !is.na(Latitude), !is.na(Priority_IUCN)) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326)

fuse_sf <- combined_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(Longitude), !is.na(Latitude), !is.na(Priority_FUSE)) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326)

edge2_sf <- combined_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(Longitude), !is.na(Latitude), !is.na(Priority_EDGE2)) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326)

st_crs(iucn_sf)  <- st_crs(meow_ecos)
st_crs(fuse_sf)  <- st_crs(meow_ecos)
st_crs(edge2_sf) <- st_crs(meow_ecos)

# ---- Ecoregion stats per index ----
iucn_with_ecoregion <- st_join(iucn_sf, meow_ecos %>% dplyr::select(ECOREGION, REALM))
ecoregion_iucn_stats <- iucn_with_ecoregion %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(ECOREGION, REALM) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_priority  = mean(Priority_IUCN, na.rm = TRUE),
    priority_cells = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ECOREGION))

fuse_with_ecoregion <- st_join(fuse_sf, meow_ecos %>% dplyr::select(ECOREGION, REALM))
ecoregion_fuse_stats <- fuse_with_ecoregion %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(ECOREGION, REALM) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_priority  = mean(Priority_FUSE, na.rm = TRUE),
    priority_cells = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ECOREGION))

edge2_with_ecoregion <- st_join(edge2_sf, meow_ecos %>% dplyr::select(ECOREGION, REALM))
ecoregion_edge2_stats <- edge2_with_ecoregion %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(ECOREGION, REALM) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_priority  = mean(Priority_EDGE2, na.rm = TRUE),
    priority_cells = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ECOREGION))

# ---- Merge fishing and priority ----
ecoregion_combined_iucn <- inner_join(ecoregion_fishing_stats, ecoregion_iucn_stats,
                                       by = c("ECOREGION", "REALM")) %>%
  mutate(cell_ratio = fishing_cells / priority_cells)

ecoregion_combined_fuse <- inner_join(ecoregion_fishing_stats, ecoregion_fuse_stats,
                                       by = c("ECOREGION", "REALM")) %>%
  mutate(cell_ratio = fishing_cells / priority_cells)

ecoregion_combined_edge2 <- inner_join(ecoregion_fishing_stats, ecoregion_edge2_stats,
                                        by = c("ECOREGION", "REALM")) %>%
  mutate(cell_ratio = fishing_cells / priority_cells)

# ---- Labelling ----
get_labels <- function(data) {
  top_fishing  <- data %>% arrange(desc(mean_fishing_hours)) %>% head(5) %>% pull(ECOREGION)
  top_priority <- data %>% arrange(desc(mean_priority))     %>% head(5) %>% pull(ECOREGION)
  data %>% filter(ECOREGION %in% unique(c(top_fishing, top_priority)))
}

label_data_iucn  <- get_labels(ecoregion_combined_iucn)
label_data_fuse  <- get_labels(ecoregion_combined_fuse)
label_data_edge2 <- get_labels(ecoregion_combined_edge2)

# ---- Shared colour scale ----
all_realms <- sort(unique(c(
  ecoregion_combined_iucn$REALM,
  ecoregion_combined_fuse$REALM,
  ecoregion_combined_edge2$REALM
)))

realm_colors <- setNames(
  RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(min(length(all_realms), 12), "Paired")[seq_along(all_realms)],
  all_realms
)

# ---- Plot function ----
make_ecoregion_plot <- function(data, label_data, panel_title) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = mean_fishing_hours, y = mean_priority)) +
    geom_point(aes(size = fishing_cells, color = REALM), alpha = 0.4) +
    geom_label_repel(
      data = label_data,
      aes(label = ECOREGION),
      size = 3, max.overlaps = 10, box.padding = 0.5
    ) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "Number of cells", range = c(1, 8)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = realm_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(
      title = panel_title,
      x = "Mean fishing hours (log scale)",
      y = "Mean conservation priority"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold.italic", hjust = 0, size = 12),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
    )
}

iucn_ecoregion_plot  <- make_ecoregion_plot(ecoregion_combined_iucn,  label_data_iucn,
  "(A) IUCN Red List threat status")
fuse_ecoregion_plot  <- make_ecoregion_plot(ecoregion_combined_fuse,  label_data_fuse,
  "(B) Functionally Unique Specialised and Endangered")
edge2_ecoregion_plot <- make_ecoregion_plot(ecoregion_combined_edge2, label_data_edge2,
  "(C) Evolutionary Distinct and Globally Endangered")

# ---- Extract shared legend ----
legend_plot <- ggplot(ecoregion_combined_iucn,
                      aes(x = mean_fishing_hours, y = mean_priority)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = fishing_cells, color = REALM), alpha = 0.4) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Number of cells", range = c(1, 8)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = realm_colors, drop = FALSE, name = "Realm") +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4, alpha = 1)),
    size  = guide_legend()
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

legend_grob <- cowplot::get_legend(legend_plot)

# ---- Combine into 2x2 grid ----
combined_ecoregion_plots <- ggpubr::ggarrange(
  iucn_ecoregion_plot,
  fuse_ecoregion_plot,
  edge2_ecoregion_plot,
  ggpubr::as_ggplot(legend_grob),
  ncol = 2, nrow = 2
)

combined_ecoregion_plots <- combined_ecoregion_plots +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA))

ggsave(here::here("R", "Outputs", "FigS11_ecoregion_priority_fishing.png"),
       combined_ecoregion_plots,
       width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```
